skill.name: image-to-video
skill.description: Routes image-to-video requests to the appropriate RunComfy model for still-image animation, voiceover lip-sync, or multimodal reference video creation.
skill.summary: Routes still images, audio, and reference media to RunComfy video models.
skill.author: agentspace-so

security_audit.summary: Most static alerts are Markdown syntax, placeholder URLs, or documented token-path prose. Confirmed issues are RunComfy CLI execution and third-party processing of prompts and media URLs. No prompt-injection attempt or stealthy exfiltration text was found.

remediation.suggestion: Ask for user confirmation before installing @runcomfy/cli or running runcomfy commands. Document the trusted package source.
Warn users before submitting private prompts, images, audio, or video URLs to RunComfy. Link to the relevant privacy policy.
Recommend RUNCOMFY_TOKEN for CI. Avoid logging token paths or values, and remind users to revoke unused tokens.

content.value_statement: Choosing the right image-to-video model can waste credits and time. This skill routes each request to a suitable RunComfy model and supplies focused prompts.
actual_capabilities: Routes still-image animation requests to HappyHorse 1.0 I2V by default.
Selects Wan 2.7 when a custom voiceover audio URL should drive lip-sync.
Selects Seedance 2.0 Pro for image, video, and audio reference workflows.
Lists required fields, media limits, durations, resolutions, and routing rules.
Provides motion, camera, lighting, and preservation prompting guidance.
Explains RunComfy CLI setup, output download behavior, and troubleshooting codes.
limitations: Requires the RunComfy CLI, a RunComfy account, and authentication before use.
Requires source media URLs that the RunComfy service can access.
Sends prompts and media URLs to RunComfy for remote processing.
Uses one model route per call and does not stitch multiple outputs together.

use_cases.title: Animate Product or Portrait Images
use_cases.description: Turn a still image into a short clip with controlled motion, stable identity, and clear camera direction.

use_cases.title: Create Voiceover Lip-Sync Clips
use_cases.description: Use an existing audio track to generate a talking-head style clip with matched duration and framing.

use_cases.title: Combine Reference Media
use_cases.description: Use image, video, and audio references together when a clip needs subject, scene, and voice cues.

prompt_templates.title: Basic Still Image Animation
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner request with one image and a simple motion goal.
prompt_templates.prompt: Animate this image into a 5 second video. Use a gentle camera drift, subtle subject motion, and stable background geometry.

prompt_templates.title: Product Reveal Prompt
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate request focused on preserving product shape and branding.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a product reveal from this image. Preserve packaging details, add a slow orbit, and use clean studio lighting.

prompt_templates.title: Custom Voiceover Lip-Sync
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced request with an audio URL and a talking-head output target.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use my voiceover audio URL for lip-sync. Frame the speaker in a medium close-up with warm lighting and matched clip duration.

prompt_templates.title: Multimodal Reference Clip
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced request using image, video, and audio references together.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use image 1 for the subject, video 1 for scene motion, and audio 1 for voice tone. Create a coherent branded clip.

output_examples.input: A user asks to animate a portrait with subtle breathing and a slow push-in.
output_examples.output: The skill selects HappyHorse 1.0 I2V and returns a focused motion prompt with identity preservation guidance.

output_examples.input: A user provides a voiceover audio URL for a short vertical spokesperson clip.
output_examples.output: The skill selects Wan 2.7, matches duration to the audio, and prepares a talking-head prompt.

output_examples.input: A user provides a subject image, a cafe reference video, and a voice reference audio file.
output_examples.output: The skill selects Seedance 2.0 Pro and maps each reference to subject, scene, and voice behavior.

best_practices: Start prompts with the main motion, camera move, and lighting change.
Use source images for details that must stay stable, such as face, costume, or product shape.
Match requested duration to audio length when using voiceover lip-sync.
anti_patterns: Do not mix unrelated visual styles across image and video references.
Do not ask one route to combine features that require different model calls.
Do not submit private or licensed media URLs without permission and privacy review.

faq.question: What does this skill do?
faq.answer: It routes image-to-video requests to RunComfy models and supplies prompt guidance for each route.

faq.question: Which model is used by default?
faq.answer: HappyHorse 1.0 I2V is the default for general portrait, product, and still-image animation requests.

faq.question: Can it use custom voiceover audio?
faq.answer: Yes. It routes custom voiceover lip-sync requests to Wan 2.7 with an audio URL.

faq.question: Can it combine image, video, and audio references?
faq.answer: Yes. It uses Seedance 2.0 Pro when a request needs multiple reference media types.

faq.question: Does it run locally only?
faq.answer: No. The local CLI submits prompts and media URLs to RunComfy for remote model processing.

faq.question: What should users prepare before running it?
faq.answer: Users need the RunComfy CLI, authentication, and media URLs that the RunComfy service can access.
